test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions I and II. Consider the statements as true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts and then decide which of the conclusions logically follow from the statements.

Statements :

No computer is remote.

Some televisions are machines.

All machines are computers.

Conclusions :

I. No remote is machine.

II. Some computers are televisions.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64c1ded0a4d5839ea4c82bbc956541a1ab41b27dc0a96191a99ad48569927aab.png] 

Conclusions :

I. No remote is machine - **TRUE **(no remote is computer and the part of machine that is in computer is also not remote so the statement follows).

II. Some computers are televisions - TRUE (As it can be clearly seen from the image some computer are tv follows)

So, **both option 1 and 2 are correct.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1"**
